replies.author: Grodu
replies.text:
I would really second this. Every single day, I receive spam phone calls from unknown numbers. Unfortunately, I cannot simply block unknown numbers, as some calls are valid. However, I note that most spam calls are very similar, with only the last two digits or so changing. Having wildcards for unknown numbers would allow me to list only a few numbers and get rid of 99% of my spam.

I am no developer, but I have used regex before and that would seem rather straightforward to implement, no?

Thanks a lot!

replies.author: de0u
replies.text: Grodu At the moment the GrapheneOS team is not focused on adding features to the AOSP dialer, in part because it may be replaced instead. But it is possible that a third-party dialer might have more-flexible blocking features.

replies.author: p-m
replies.text: de0u Hi, do you know more about a future replacement of the dialer please, an ETA?
